description: Collision for a model: a set of convex hulls that hug the shape (V-HACD), ready for Godot (-convcolonly nodes), Unreal (UCX_ names) and Unity (convex MeshColliders via an editor script), plus hulls.json for any engine and a see-through overlay to check. Price: $0.15 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of GLB optimizer: Make a GLB small and fast for the web or mobile: dedup, instance, join, weld, simplify, resize and re-encode textures, meshopt or draco compression.

maxHulls.description: Upper limit; the fewest hulls that fit the shape (within 3% of the volume the limit gives) are used.

maxVerticesPerHull.description: 64 keeps every hull valid for Unity convex MeshColliders (255 polygons).

resolution.description: Voxels used to read the shape; higher follows small details.

name: glb_optimizer_colliders
